websites.hook: Make your website worthy of your business.
websites.problemHeadline: When the business has moved on, but the website has not.

pains.title: An unclear story
pains.body: Visitors have to piece together what you do and whether it is right for them.

pains.title: A disconnected journey
pains.body: The site looks finished, but enquiries, bookings or publishing still need manual work.

pains.title: A site nobody can own
pains.body: Every small update becomes another request to a developer.

benefits.title: A clearer first impression
benefits.body: We organize your pages and copy around the questions customers need answered.

benefits.title: Design and delivery together
benefits.body: The visual identity, build and connected journeys are reviewed as one experience.

benefits.title: A site your team can manage
benefits.body: The agreed CMS, access and documentation are part of the handover.

websites.solutionHeadline: One website. From first impression to next step.
scopeHeadlines: Explain the business. Make it recognizable.
Build the journey. Prepare the launch.

ecommerce.hook: Make every part of the store work together.
ecommerce.problemHeadline: When the storefront and the operation fall out of step.

pains.title: An inconsistent buying experience
pains.body: The brand, product pages and checkout journey feel like separate projects.

pains.title: Too much manual upkeep
pains.body: Catalog, inventory and customer data move between disconnected tools.

pains.title: A launch with loose ends
pains.body: The site is ready, but channels, notifications or store operations are not.

benefits.title: A joined-up launch
benefits.body: Brand implementation, catalog setup and the buying experience share one agreed scope.

benefits.title: Connections with a purpose
benefits.body: We connect the store to the inventory, marketing and operating tools it needs.

benefits.title: A store you can operate
benefits.body: Test orders and a practical handover prepare your team for the agreed workflows.

ecommerce.solutionHeadline: A considered storefront. A working operation.
scopeHeadlines: Build the brand and the store together.
Connect the buying journey to your operations.
Improve, migrate or connect the store.

software-solutions.hook: Build the product your business actually needs.
software-solutions.problemHeadline: When the tools no longer fit the way you work.

pains.title: A fragmented experience
pains.body: Customers, staff and owners work across tools that were never designed together.

pains.title: A prototype without a path to launch
pains.body: The idea is visible, but accounts, data, integrations and operations remain unfinished.

pains.title: Unclear ownership
pains.body: You need to know who controls the code, deployment and data after delivery.

benefits.title: One coherent product
benefits.body: The public website, customer application and owner tools are built around the same journeys.

benefits.title: A useful first release
benefits.body: We define the priority workflows and distinguish a prototype from a production build.

benefits.title: A practical handover
benefits.body: Commissioned code, deployment and data are handed over under the agreed terms; support is optional.

software-solutions.solutionHeadline: The website. The application. The tools to run it.
scopeHeadlines: Connect the first visit to the product.
Build for customers and the people running it.
Connect the data. Hand over the product.

ai-solutions.hook: Give AI a real job in your business.
ai-solutions.problemHeadline: When the demo works, but the workflow does not.

pains.title: Missing business context
pains.body: An agent cannot do useful work with the right instructions but the wrong information.

pains.title: Disconnected tools
pains.body: People still move inputs and outputs between the agent and the systems they use.

pains.title: Outputs nobody can trust
pains.body: There is no agreed way to judge results, handle mistakes or approve important actions.

benefits.title: A task worth building around
benefits.body: We start with real examples and a defined job, then test the uncertain behavior first.

benefits.title: Useful access, with boundaries
benefits.body: The agent gets the agreed tools and context, with permissions and review steps.

benefits.title: Operation your team can inspect
benefits.body: Evaluation, cost controls and recovery are scoped alongside deployment and handover.

ai-solutions.solutionHeadline: A defined task. Connected tools. Reviewed results.
scopeHeadlines: Put the agent where the work happens.
Build around the tools and evidence it needs.
Connect the agent to the application.

agent-teams.hook: Turn separate agents into a coordinated team.
agent-teams.problemHeadline: When more agents create more coordination work.

pains.title: Work without clear ownership
pains.body: Tasks overlap or disappear between agents with loosely defined roles.

pains.title: Context lost at handoff
pains.body: Each worker starts again because the relevant information does not travel with the job.

pains.title: Outputs without a reviewed result
pains.body: Separate answers arrive, but someone still has to check and combine them.

benefits.title: Roles built around the work
benefits.body: We map the workflow before assigning a manager and specialist workers.

benefits.title: Deliberate handoffs
benefits.body: Shared context, tool permissions and escalation rules connect each stage.

benefits.title: One reviewable result
benefits.body: The manager reconciles outputs, while failed or blocked jobs remain visible.

agent-teams.solutionHeadline: The right roles. A shared workflow.
scopeHeadlines: Build the team around the workflow.

agent-infrastructure.hook: Give your agents a dependable place to work.
agent-infrastructure.problemHeadline: When the experiment needs an operating environment.

pains.title: Execution tied to a local setup
pains.body: The agent works in development but has no defined deployment or operating path.

pains.title: Failures are hard to inspect
pains.body: Task state, tool calls and retries are difficult to follow or recover.

pains.title: Controls added too late
pains.body: Permissions, usage limits and operator responsibilities are still undefined.

benefits.title: An environment that fits
benefits.body: We configure an existing harness or build the execution behavior your agent requires.

benefits.title: Visibility into the run
benefits.body: Task state, logs and recovery paths help operators understand what happened.

benefits.title: Controls from the start
benefits.body: Tool permissions, time and usage limits are part of the agreed build.

agent-infrastructure.solutionHeadline: Execution, tools and operating controls. Together.
scopeHeadlines: Build the environment. Define the controls.

jev-implementation.problemHeadline: When a repeated decision controls what happens next.

pains.title: Unstructured decisions
pains.body: Your application needs a defined category or route, rather than another open-ended answer.

pains.title: Unclear uncertainty
pains.body: The workflow has no agreed rule for when to proceed, switch routes or ask for review.

pains.title: An integration without evaluation
pains.body: The decision logic has not been compared with representative, reviewed examples.

benefits.title: A decision your software can use
benefits.body: We define the schema and connect Jev to a specific branch in your system.

benefits.title: A deliberate fallback
benefits.body: Thresholds and uncertainty paths determine when a result needs another route or human review.

benefits.title: A testable implementation
benefits.body: Reviewed examples exercise the routes and failure cases before the integration is handed over.

jev-implementation.solutionHeadline: Context becomes a decision. The workflow knows what follows.
scopeHeadlines: Turn context into an actionable decision.
Evaluate the result. Define the fallback.

context-and-memory.hook: Give your agents the context they keep missing.
context-and-memory.problemHeadline: When useful knowledge never reaches the task.

pains.title: The same briefing, again
pains.body: People repeat information because an agent does not retain the context it needs.

pains.title: Sources that are hard to find
pains.body: Important business knowledge is spread across documents and systems.

pains.title: Information without clear rules
pains.body: Freshness, access, updates and deletion are not consistently defined.

benefits.title: Context shaped around the task
benefits.body: We organize the business sources and task state your agents need to use.

benefits.title: Retrieval checked against real questions
benefits.body: Storage and search are selected for the workload, then tested with representative examples.

benefits.title: Knowledge you can maintain
benefits.body: Update, access and deletion behavior are defined with your source owners.

context-and-memory.solutionHeadline: Your sources. Relevant retrieval. Controlled memory.
scopeHeadlines: Organize, retrieve and maintain the context.

mcp-and-api.hook: Connect the tools your work depends on.
mcp-and-api.problemHeadline: When one missing connection holds the workflow back.

pains.title: Manual transfer between systems
pains.body: People copy data or repeat actions because applications do not share a working interface.

pains.title: Private tools beyond the agent’s reach
pains.body: A useful business system has no supported agent-facing connection.

pains.title: Access without clear boundaries
pains.body: Authentication, permitted actions and failure behavior need to be defined together.

benefits.title: The right connection for the job
benefits.body: We use an existing supported integration where it fits, or build the missing API or MCP interface.

benefits.title: Permissions built into the interface
benefits.body: Tool contracts, validation and authorization define what each client can do.

benefits.title: A connection your team can maintain
benefits.body: The handover includes interface documentation, deployment details and agreed operational checks.

mcp-and-api.solutionHeadline: A working interface between your systems.
scopeHeadlines: Connect existing tools or build the missing interface.
Bring the connection into the product.

creative-ai-workflows.hook: Bring the whole creative workflow together.
creative-ai-workflows.problemHeadline: When generating an asset is only the first step.

pains.title: A brief lost between tools
pains.body: Brand context and references do not reliably follow the work into generation.

pains.title: Review scattered across files
pains.body: Versions, feedback and approvals become difficult to track.

pains.title: Delivery still done by hand
pains.body: Jobs finish, but outputs still need organizing, checking and exporting.

benefits.title: The actual brief stays in view
benefits.body: Brand context, references and intended placement inform the connected workflow.

benefits.title: Review remains part of production
benefits.body: Generation leads into explicit review and refinement, rather than automatic publishing.

benefits.title: Outputs prepared for their destination
benefits.body: Agreed file types, dimensions and delivery connections are checked end to end.

creative-ai-workflows.solutionHeadline: From approved brief to reviewed delivery.
scopeHeadlines: Carry the brief into image and video production.
Connect audio, agents and final review.

ai-setup-and-consulting.hook: Make the tools useful to the people using them.
ai-setup-and-consulting.problemHeadline: When access to AI has not become a working practice.

pains.title: Tools without a clear use
pains.body: The team has accounts, but no defined workflow to configure or evaluate.

pains.title: A setup that does not connect
pains.body: The right context, repository or business tools are missing from the environment.

pains.title: An uncertain handover
pains.body: Users do not know how to operate the setup or what it will cost to run.

benefits.title: A setup with a purpose
benefits.body: We start with the intended work, then verify the exact product and supported access.

benefits.title: Configuration around your team
benefits.body: Context, instructions and agreed tool connections are configured for representative tasks.

benefits.title: A practical introduction
benefits.body: Your team receives a walkthrough, usage guidance and the configuration handover.

ai-setup-and-consulting.solutionHeadline: The right setup. A workflow your team can use.
scopeHeadlines: Configure the environment around the workflow.
Verify the product, access and setup path.

brand.hook: Build an identity that carries through the business.
brand.problemHeadline: When the brand changes from one touchpoint to the next.

pains.title: An identity that feels unfinished
pains.body: The logo exists, but typography, imagery and applications do not hold together.

pains.title: Guidelines without usable assets
pains.body: The team still improvises every new page, document or campaign.

pains.title: A gap between design and implementation
pains.body: The approved direction has not made it into the website, store or product.

benefits.title: A direction grounded in the business
benefits.body: We agree the audience and visual direction through representative applications.

benefits.title: A brand kit people can use
benefits.body: The agreed assets, templates and guidance support the channels your team works in.

benefits.title: Implementation in context
benefits.body: We apply and review the identity on the actual digital surfaces in scope.

brand.solutionHeadline: A considered identity. A usable system.
scopeHeadlines: Define the identity. Make it usable.
Carry the brand into its real applications.

unslop.hook: Bring the work up to the standard of your business.
unslop.problemHeadline: When the starting point is there, but the quality is not.

pains.title: Design that could belong to anyone
pains.body: Generic layouts and inconsistent branding weaken the character of the work.

pains.title: Copy that does not say enough
pains.body: Repetition and vague language obscure the business and its offer.

pains.title: A journey that breaks down
pains.body: The pages look complete, but the mobile layout, forms or next steps fall short.

benefits.title: Keep what is worth keeping
benefits.body: We inspect the actual work before recommending repair or a rebuild.

benefits.title: Agree the standard in context
benefits.body: A representative correction establishes the direction before wider changes.

benefits.title: Finish with a checked result
benefits.body: Design, editorial and functional changes are reviewed against the agreed scope.

unslop.solutionHeadline: A focused repair. A more considered result.
scopeHeadlines: Preserve the foundation. Repair the experience.
Set a clear standard for the writing and the work.

consultation.hook: Make the next decision with a clear plan.
consultation.problemHeadline: When the next commitment needs a better answer.

pains.title: Too many plausible options
pains.body: Platforms, architectures or suppliers offer different tradeoffs without a clear recommendation.

pains.title: A problem without a diagnosis
pains.body: Symptoms are visible, but the evidence does not yet explain the cause.

pains.title: A proposal with unanswered questions
pains.body: Dependencies, ownership or acceptance remain unclear before work begins.

benefits.title: An answer to a defined question
benefits.body: We agree the decision and inspection scope before the review begins.

benefits.title: Tradeoffs made explicit
benefits.body: The assessment separates evidence, assumptions, practical options and remaining gaps.

benefits.title: A plan you can use independently
benefits.body: Take the written recommendation to your own team, Fortitudo or another provider.

consultation.solutionHeadline: A diagnosis. A recommendation. A practical next step.
scopeHeadlines: Turn the objective or problem into a plan.
Review the technical and customer experience.
Clarify the implementation before committing.
